title: Global Learning & Talent Development Specialist (m/f/d)
company: Hellmann Worldwide Logistics SE & Co. KG
description:
**About Us**
============


Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward\-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? Then become part of our FAMILY that consists of around 10\.000 employees in more than 200 locations worldwide.  

For the better. Together.

  


Are you ready to take the next step in your career? As a Global Talent and Organization Development Senior (m/f/d) at Hellmann Worldwide Logistics, you will play a key role in shaping our global HR landscape. This position offers a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting HR transformation journey—where you take ownership, drive innovation, and collaborate with a team of passionate professionals. **About the job**


Learning strategy and capability building

* Develop and deliver a global learning and capability\-building strategy aligned with business priorities and our people strategy.
* Run learning needs analyses and identify capability gaps across functions, regions and talent groups.
* Build capability frameworks and learning roadmaps that support organizational growth and transformation.
* Translate business requirements into practical, sustainable learning solutions.


Learning design and development

* Design, develop and continuously improve learning solutions for classroom, virtual, hybrid and self\-paced digital formats.
* Create facilitator guides, participant materials, toolkits, assessments, videos, e\-learning modules and blended programs.
* Apply modern instructional design methods and adult learning principles to keep learning engaging and effective.
* Keep content scalable, learner\-centered and globally relevant, while allowing for local adaptation.


Talent and leadership development

* Design and manage global talent and leadership development programs, including offers for emerging leaders, high potentials and critical talent groups.
* Build career development pathways and learning journeys that support career growth and internal mobility.
* Partner with stakeholders on succession\-related development and targeted capability building.
* Support onboarding, upskilling and reskilling as part of an integrated talent approach.


Organizational development

* Contribute to organizational development work such as capability modeling, role architecture and organizational effectiveness.
* Support the design of career frameworks and organizational capability assessments.
* Bring a learning lens to change and transformation initiatives.


Learning technology and measurement

* Work with our HRIS and technology teams to make the most of our learning management system and other learning technologies.
* Manage learning content deployment, learner experience, reporting and analytics.
* Measure learning effectiveness through data, feedback and business impact, and act on what you find.
* Track external trends and emerging technologies to keep our learning ecosystem current.

**About you**


Must\-have

* At least five years of experience in learning and development, talent development, instructional design or a related field.
* Experience designing and delivering global learning and talent programs in a multinational organization.
* A track record of building learning solutions across classroom, virtual, hybrid and digital channels.
* Experience designing leadership development or talent acceleration programs.
* Experience building learning journeys, development pathways or career frameworks.
* Experience working with a learning management system.
* Strong knowledge of instructional design methods, for example ADDIE, SAM, design thinking or learning experience design, and a solid grounding in adult learning theory.
* A degree in HR, organizational psychology, education, learning sciences, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Excellent communication and storytelling, strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, and a global, intercultural mindset.
* The ability to balance strategic work with hands\-on execution.


Nice\-to\-have

* Certification in instructional design, learning experience design, adult learning, facilitation, coaching or leadership development.
* Familiarity with learning analytics and evaluation frameworks such as Kirkpatrick.
* Experience with AI\-enabled learning solutions and adaptive learning platforms.
* Experience developing large\-scale global leadership academies or enterprise reskilling initiatives.
* Knowledge of organizational design, workforce planning or change management methodologies.
* Familiarity with skills\-based talent management and career architecture frameworks.
* Additional language skills beyond English.

**How you work**


We are looking for someone whose way of working reflects our values:

* Caring. You build trusted relationships, listen well and keep learners and colleagues at the center of what you design.
* Entrepreneurial. You take ownership, show initiative and stay focused on the impact your work has on the business.
* Forward\-Thinking. You bring curiosity and a digital mindset, and you keep improving how we learn and develop.
* Reliable. You deliver quality work on time, follow through on commitments and measure whether it worked.


Inclusion and social diversity are firmly anchored values in our corporate culture. Regardless of gender, age, any disabilities, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity: We are looking forward to meeting you!


If you are excited by this fantastic opportunity and have what it takes, then click APPLY!

title: Human Resource Business Partner
description:
In this role you will own the full HR lifecycle for employees within the function. Your responsibilities will include supporting the annual workforce planning process, tracking recruitment, enabling effective functional on\-boarding, driving performance management, career development and overseeing employee engagement and exit process management. In addition, you will work on function specific programs such as workforce transitions linked to project ramp\-ups or ramp\-downs.

A critical part of your role will be to partner with and coach managers to build a high\-performance culture. You will work closely with Recruitment, Operations, Training and Service Managers.

**Interfaces with:** Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Training, Service Managers, Service Head and MD.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Headcount plan \& Recruitment:** 

o Partner with HRM and leaders on the annual headcount plan and pacing for the year

o Track and drive recruitment in collaboration with the TA team

o Ensure timley hiring, aligned to the quality that is defined for each role.

**Onboarding \& Integration:**

o Enable structured onboarding and functional orientation for new hires

o Track assimilation with 30, 60, 90 day check\-ins and the confirmation process

**Performance Management \& Career Development:**

o Partner with business leaders to set clear goals for the annual review period

o Drive the monthly performance management process (KPIs) with clarity and rigour

o Put in place Performance Improvement plans (PIPs) to support weak performers

o Enable career development and internal mobility discussions

**Employee Engagement \& Retention:**

o Conduct regular check\-ins and proactively address employee concerns

o Handle any workplace grievances with care and urgency

o Cascade all events at a functional level, encouraging participation at site.

o Reduce voluntary attrition by 10\-15% year over year.

**Business Partnering \& Manager Capability:**

o Educate Managers and on the various people processes

o Increase ownership of people processes with managers

**HR Process Excellence \& Projects:**

o Refine the role of Site HR \& improve from process coordination to process ownership

o Partner with COEs to implement processes with high consistency and compliance

o Reduce gaps in workflows and processes between the COE teams and Site HR

o Drive function specific projects effectively with the help and alignment of COEs

**Headcount plan \& Recruitment:** % alignment to annual plan, Average Time to Fill

**Onboarding, Engagement \& Retention:** New hire confirm rate, % of employees covered through listening circles, Voluntary attrition rate.

**Performance Management**: Average KPI, Rating Spread, etc.

**Business Partnering \& Managers**: Improve quality of people decisions, Reduce escalations

**HR Excellence Key Projects**:

* Delivery on key projects and stakeholder feedback
* Strong Partnering and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to balance operational execution with strategic thinking
* Clear, structured communication and influencing ability
* Comfort with data and ability to derive actionable insights
* High ownership, responsiveness, and problem\-solving mindset

Pay: ₹60,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: HR Central Supervisor
description:
The role focuses on leading the delivery of HR administrative services across the employee lifecycle within the HR Shared Services function, ensuring service delivery to internal and external customers is accurate, efficient, and aligned with agreed SLAs, performance metrics, and service standards.


The HR Central Supervisor will oversee day\-to\-day HR service delivery activities, including employee onboarding, employee lifecycle transactions, and terminations. Responsibilities include team leadership, workload management, process governance, stakeholder engagement, Help Desk ticket management, HR systems administration, data reporting, and continuous process improvement.


The Supervisor will work closely with HR, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Benefits teams, and other business stakeholders to ensure employee data is maintained accurately within HR systems and that all employee lifecycle transactions are processed in line with payroll deadlines, compliance requirements, and organizational standards.


The role requires strong leadership, operational oversight, problem\-solving ability, and customer service focus. The successful candidate will be responsible for coaching and developing HR Central Representatives, monitoring operational performance, managing escalations, and driving consistency across HR administrative processes while supporting the ongoing development of the HR Central function.


The HR Central Supervisor will report directly to the Regional HR Central Manager.


  
* Lead a team of administrators to deliver key HR processes as part of the Onboarding, Employee Lifecycle and Termination activities.
* Coordinate the day\-to\-day activities of the HR Central Representative roles.
* Ensure Help Desk requests are monitored and distributed across the team to achieve optimum performance against SLAs.
* Ensure the team is appropriately staffed and upskilled to meet service delivery demands, including supporting training activities and onboarding documentation for new team members.
* Provide direction, coaching, mentoring, and performance oversight to administrators.
* Ensure team performance is measured and monitored in line with service delivery SLAs and KPIs, and take appropriate action where performance does not meet expectations.
* Act as the second\-level escalation point for urgent requests, customer issues, and service delivery concerns, providing support and resolution as required.
* Manage relationships between HR Central, Regional Payroll, and other key stakeholders through regular communication and feedback mechanisms.
* Work with In\-country HR, Regional Payroll, Talent Acquisition, and Benefits teams to monitor and streamline HR administrative processes in line with the wider HR service offering.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure contractual templates, job\-specific checklists, work instructions, and documentation are compliant and controlled in accordance with company standards.
* Oversee improvements and implement best practices across HR Central and wider HR administrative processes.
* Partner with other HR Central leads to share best practices and promote consistency and alignment of activities globally.
* Utilize HR Help Desk reporting and analytics to identify trends, investigate issues, and recommend improvements to the employee experience.
* Prepare and distribute operational and status reports to stakeholders, highlighting progress, risks, and blockers where appropriate.
* Ensure HR system data integrity procedures are followed through regular audits, reviews, and adherence to established processes.
* Provide operational input and support decision\-making for projects, transition activities, and business\-as\-usual operations.
* The successful candidate will work under the guidance of the Regional HR Central Manager, who will oversee workload priorities, operational objectives, and team performance expectations.

  
* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
* Up to 7 years of overall HR experience, including at least 2 years of experience within an HR Shared Services, HR Operations, HR Services, or HR Administration environment.
* Experience supporting employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, employee changes, and termination activities.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced corporate environment with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Experience working within HR service delivery, shared services, help desk, or administrative support functions is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing or coordinating team activities, mentoring colleagues, or supporting team performance objectives is preferred.
* Experience working with KPI\-driven service delivery environments and meeting performance targets and service standards.
* Working knowledge of HRIS platforms, preferably Oracle HCM, or other enterprise HR systems.
* Experience working with Help Desk, CRM, Service Management, or Ticket Management systems is preferred.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 applications including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
* Strong analytical skills with experience handling, validating, and reporting HR\-related data.
* Excellent attention to detail with a strong commitment to data accuracy, compliance, and confidentiality.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with employees, stakeholders, and senior management.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for service delivery outcomes, resolving issues, and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ability to coach, mentor, and support team members while fostering a collaborative and customer\-focused work environment.
* Strong organizational, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills with the ability to adapt to changing priorities.
* Excellent spoken and written English language skills; additional language skills such as Spanish are advantageous.
* Maintains a customer\-centric mindset while ensuring service quality, operational excellence, and compliance with company procedures.
